services.name: Audio Guide
services.desc: Would you like to explore the Toronto Railway Museum at your own pace? Our audio guide provides extra information about our exhibits, available on your own device! To access the audio guide, click here. Please note that our audio guide is only available in both English and Ukrainian. We offer two guides for the museum. Our indoor audio guide teaches you about the exhibits we have inside the museum at stall 17. Here you can learn about cross-country train travel on The Canadian, local commuter travel on GO Transit, or the history of the John Street Roundhouse. Our outdoor guide provides more fun facts about our large artifacts. These include the rolling stock and locomotives (the “trains”)

services.name: Easter Chocolate Tasting
services.desc: Step aboard a beautifully restored vintage train car and settle in for a one-of-a-kind Easter chocolate experience. Our Easter Chocolate Express invites you to explore the world of artisanal Canadian craft chocolate in a setting full of character and charm. Guided by a chocolate expert, you’ll uncover the story of cacao, from its origins to its modern craft production. Along the way, you will taste your way through a curated flight of craft chocolates and learn how to savour like a true connoisseur. Best of all, take home your own chocolate tasting kit to relive the experience and make many more memories as sweet as chocolate. Note that this event focuses on the darker spectrum of chocolate
